name: SSR
description: Screen-space reflections (pre-tonemap). Reflects low-roughness surfaces via gbuffer roughness; with HDR off, u_ldr_roughness applies to all surfaces. Distances are WORLD units (1 unit = 1 cm).

uniforms.name: u_thickness
uniforms.tip: Minimum registered surface thickness (WORLD units). The acceptance gap also floors at one ray step automatically, so thin surfaces can't be skipped.

uniforms.name: u_max_distance
uniforms.tip: Max ray distance in WORLD units. ~30 for a vase, ~1000 for 20 m outdoor.

uniforms.name: u_ldr_roughness
uniforms.tip: Fallback roughness for every surface when HDR is off (no roughness channel in the LDR gbuffer).
